title: Generative model
bullets: Conditional diffusion model (4.0M parameters) and VAE trained on the Jetson from 13,076 real frames, whole trials held out
Diffusion training: 53 min, ~18.5 W, ~59 kJ (16 Wh); held-out loss still falling, so undertrained
HT matches real in occupied scenes (two people 0.1038 vs 0.1040); empty room 17% low
Pixel noise is 60–75% of real (52–77 vs 79–116 mK); VAE is 5–10× too smooth
YOLO finds the single person in 8–16% of generated frames vs 80–100% real
Cannot produce a lamp without a person, and has no fog or crowd data
Sampling: 23 frames/s at 10 steps, 4.6 at 50 steps
Verdict: in-distribution A0/A1-like frames only; no nearest-neighbour sign of memorisation
notes: results/thermal-generative/metric_table.md, logs/, harness_runs.csv. Single seed, 6 held-out trials, 2 harness repeats. Checkpoints are on the Jetson only.
